name: Robust Intelligence
tagline: Enterprise AI risk management platform for continuous LLM security, threat protection, and red teaming.
definition: Robust Intelligence (acquired by Cisco) is an enterprise AI risk management and firewall platform. It automatically red-teams AI models, detects prompt injection attacks, prevents data leakage (DLP), and validates model safety before and during production deployment.
why_it_matters: As enterprise LLM deployments expanded, security threats like prompt injection, jailbreaking, and sensitive data leakage became major risks. Robust Intelligence provides continuous automated security firewall protection across models.
workplace_use_cases: Blocking real-time prompt injection and jailbreak attacks on customer-facing chatbots
Preventing sensitive PII or corporate secrets from leaking in LLM responses (DLP)
Automating red-teaming vulnerability scans across internal LLMs prior to release
Generating compliance auditing reports for enterprise AI governance boards
how_to_use: Deploy Robust Intelligence AI Firewall proxies between client applications and model APIs, configure security rules, and view real-time threat detection dashboards.
key_features: AI Firewall for real-time prompt injection and toxic output blocking
Automated Algorithmic Red Teaming for identifying model vulnerabilities
Data Loss Prevention (DLP) filters for credit card numbers, PII, and API keys
Compliance reporting for NIST AI Risk Management Framework and EU AI Act

pricing.free_tier_details: Enterprise security consultation and demos available.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Security Contract
paid_plans.notes: Custom pricing calculated per deployed model endpoints and API request volume.

name: Lakera Guard
tagline: Real-time AI security API defending enterprise LLM applications against prompt injections.
definition: Lakera Guard is a real-time AI security engine that protects LLM applications from prompt injection, data exfiltration, toxicity, and system prompt leakage. It acts as an inline security API gateway with sub-50ms latency.
why_it_matters: Lakera built Gandalf (the viral prompt injection security game), harvesting millions of real-world attack vectors to build the industry's most robust real-time threat intelligence database for LLM safety.
workplace_use_cases: Sanitizing user inputs to prevent indirect prompt injection attacks in enterprise chatbots
Securing RAG applications from malicious document injection vulnerabilities
Monitoring enterprise LLM usage for regulatory compliance and safety violations
Blocking system prompt disclosure attempts by malicious external users
how_to_use: Integrate Lakera Guard API into your application code (`lakera.guard(prompt)`), pass user prompts through Lakera before sending to your LLM, and block flagged requests.
key_features: Sub-50ms ultra-low latency real-time prompt injection detection API
Trained on real-world threat dataset from millions of Gandalf game attack prompts
Data Loss Prevention (PII, secret keys, confidential text)
Zero data retention mode for strict enterprise compliance

pricing.free_tier_details: Free Developer plan includes up to 10,000 security scans per month.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Includes 100,000 security scans/month, custom threat category rules.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: Volume discounts, VPC/on-prem deployment, custom SLAs, dedicated support.

name: Credal.ai
tagline: Enterprise AI security proxy enforcing data access controls and preventing PII leaks across LLMs.
definition: Credal.ai is an enterprise AI security gateway that allows companies to safely deploy LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude) while enforcing internal Slack/SharePoint permissions and preventing PII leakage.
why_it_matters: Credal enables enterprise IT teams to connect corporate data sources to LLMs without risking permission boundary breaches.
workplace_use_cases: Enforcing user-level document security permissions when querying internal AI knowledge bases
Redacting PII and sensitive source code before sending prompts to third-party LLMs
Monitoring company-wide LLM usage for SOC 2 compliance auditing
how_to_use: Deploy Credal gateway proxies between enterprise applications and LLM providers.
key_features: Real-time PII and secret key redaction
Document permission sync with Slack, Google Drive, and SharePoint
SOC 2 Type II audit logging dashboard

pricing.free_tier_details: Custom enterprise quotes based on organization user count.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Security Gateway
paid_plans.notes: Calculated per active enterprise seat and LLM gateway traffic.

name: Prompt Security
tagline: Enterprise platform protecting organizations from shadow AI usage, data leaks, and prompt attacks.
definition: Prompt Security is an enterprise AI security platform that inspects, audits, and secures all AI usage across employees, applications, and model APIs.
why_it_matters: Prompt Security offers full coverage against Shadow AI by discovering unapproved browser AI tools used by corporate employees.
workplace_use_cases: Discovering shadow AI browser extensions used across corporate laptops
Inspecting employee prompts for confidential company code or financial data
Protecting customer-facing AI applications from prompt injection
how_to_use: Deploy the Prompt Security browser extension or API gateway to monitor employee AI traffic.
key_features: Shadow AI discovery engine for corporate IT visibility
Real-time prompt inspection and data loss prevention (DLP)
Protection against indirect prompt injection attacks

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Security Suite
paid_plans.notes: Priced per employee seat and application endpoint protected.

name: CalypsoAI
tagline: Enterprise LLM security and AI governance platform providing real-time prompt scanning and threat prevention.
definition: CalypsoAI is an enterprise AI security platform offering real-time AI firewalls, threat monitoring, and policy enforcement across generative AI applications.
why_it_matters: CalypsoAI is trusted by government agencies and financial institutions for strict AI safety auditing.
workplace_use_cases: Enforcing corporate AI acceptable-use policies in real time
Scanning internal LLM prompts for malware, toxic content, and data leaks
Providing security audit trails for government AI compliance
how_to_use: Deploy CalypsoAI firewall proxies across corporate networks and model endpoints.
key_features: Real-time LLM prompt scanning and data loss prevention
Customizable corporate policy enforcement rules
Comprehensive AI threat analytics dashboard

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Governance Suite
paid_plans.notes: Calculated based on enterprise user seats and security endpoints.

name: HiddenLayer
tagline: MDR (Managed Detection & Response) security platform safeguarding enterprise AI models from adversarial attacks.
definition: HiddenLayer is an AI application security platform that protects enterprise machine learning models from adversarial attacks, model poisoning, and intellectual property theft.
why_it_matters: HiddenLayer provides non-invasive threat detection for ML models without requiring code changes or access to raw training data.
workplace_use_cases: Detecting adversarial attack attempts aimed at stealing proprietary ML model weights
Preventing data poisoning attacks on enterprise training datasets
Monitoring ML model inputs and outputs for security anomalies
how_to_use: Integrate HiddenLayer MLDR sensor software alongside enterprise model inference endpoints.
key_features: MLDR (Machine Learning Detection & Response) non-invasive sensor
Adversarial attack and model extraction defense
No raw model training data access required

paid_plans.name: Enterprise MLDR Contract
paid_plans.notes: Priced per enterprise model endpoint protected.

name: Protect AI
tagline: End-to-end AI application security platform securing ML pipelines, notebooks, and models.
definition: Protect AI is a developer-focused AI security platform offering tools (Guardian, NBDefense) to scan Jupyter notebooks, ML pipelines, and model artifacts for security vulnerabilities.
why_it_matters: Protect AI focuses on ML SecOps, securing the entire machine learning supply chain from notebook code to model deployment.
workplace_use_cases: Scanning Jupyter notebooks for hardcoded API keys and security flaws
Auditing open-source Hugging Face model files for embedded malware
Securing MLOps build pipelines in CI/CD
how_to_use: Install NBDefense or Protect AI Guardian scanner in your ML CI/CD build pipeline.
key_features: NBDefense for scanning Jupyter notebooks and Python scripts
Model artifact security scanner for detecting malicious model files
ML Supply Chain Security vulnerability management

pricing.free_tier_details: Free open-source scanners available for individual developers.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Platform
paid_plans.notes: Full ML SecOps pipeline security, administrative dashboard.

name: Arize Phoenix
tagline: Open-source AI observability and evaluation platform for tracing and auditing LLM applications.
definition: Arize Phoenix is an open-source AI observability platform that provides tracing, evaluation, and hallucination auditing for RAG applications and LLM pipelines.
why_it_matters: Phoenix provides developers with an open-source evaluation framework for tracing LLM execution steps locally.
workplace_use_cases: Tracing RAG application retrieval steps to audit context recall errors
Evaluating LLM response hallucination scores using benchmark metrics
Exporting execution trace logs for enterprise compliance
how_to_use: Install via `pip install arize-phoenix` and launch local tracing in your Python LLM application.
key_features: Open-source tracing and evaluation engine (Evals)
Visual execution trace graphs for RAG applications
Seamless integration with LlamaIndex and LangChain

pricing.free_tier_details: Open-source version is free to run locally. Paid hosted version available on Arize Cloud.

paid_plans.name: Arize Enterprise Cloud
paid_plans.notes: Hosted enterprise observability platform, custom SLAs.

name: WhyLabs
tagline: AI observability and data health platform monitoring model drift and data quality in production.
definition: WhyLabs is an AI observability platform that monitors machine learning models and data pipelines for data drift, performance degradation, and data quality issues.
why_it_matters: WhyLabs enables enterprise MLOps teams to catch model performance degradation before it impacts business operations.
workplace_use_cases: Monitoring production ML model feature drift over time
Detecting schema changes and missing values in automated data pipelines
Auditing LLM prompt toxicity and sentiment trends
how_to_use: Install `whylogs` in Python, generate data profiles, and send to WhyLabs dashboard.
key_features: Open-source `whylogs` profiling library with lightweight data privacy
Automated model drift and data quality alerts
Supports tabular, image, and text LLM data

pricing.free_tier_details: Free Developer tier for up to 2 model monitor projects.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited model monitoring, SOC 2 compliance, dedicated support.
